description:
LANDED 9ed080017 on wt/kdt-close (PR #110, draft), 2026-09-03. Scoped by
measurement at dd07432db, built and verified in one commit.

THE CHANGE: compiler2_dispatch_blind_escape_census_is_the_known_population
drove its 22 fixtures under settled plus SIX arm seeds. Every seed read the
same pairs with the same verdicts, so five of the six were re-reading one
fact. It now drives settled plus ONE seed (arms:6, the seed that once aborted
enum_map_family and enum_predicate_search), through a named constant
BLIND_ESCAPE_CENSUS_STRESSES. The loop stays; it is still the permutation
ratchet.

THE DERIVATION, MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN: the pair walk was
instrumented to count pairs and verdicts at every arrival, then the
instrumentation was removed. Settled and each of seeds 1-6 read 87 pairs, 36
Separated / 51 Covering / 0 Escaping -- identical at all seven arrivals, so
609 = 87 x 7 with the histogram scaling exactly 7x (252 / 357 / 0). This is
expected by construction: fz-kdt.194 gave separated pairs a canonical order
and pins artifact arrival-invariance in its own gate, so a census OF THE
ARTIFACT is arrival-invariant too.

AN INJECTION RECIPE IS NOW RECORDED, because an emptiness ratchet that
nobody has ever seen fail is not yet known to bite: widening seats_before's
covering closure to Covering | Escaping and deleting specificity_order's two
debug_asserts (which otherwise catch it first) makes the gate fail its
Reachable assert with 25 escapes at settled, and the injected population is
itself arrival-invariant (137 pairs / 36 / 76 / 25 at settled and at each
seed).

MEASURED PRIZE: the gate alone 109.0 s -> 36.9 s wall and 108.5 s -> 34.1 s
CPU; the lib suite 157.5 s -> 105.1 s wall and 705.8 s -> 620.9 s CPU. The
coordinator gate on the folded branch then read the suite at 86.6 s. Wall
clock is reported beside CPU deliberately: the machine was shared during
measurement (load 44, another agent running this project's lib tests), and
lib wall readings swung 105 / 137 / 174 s at constant CPU. Any wall-clock
acceptance criterion in this arc needs a quiet machine or should be stated in
CPU.

STEP 2 (collapsing the corpus walk in compiler2_dispatch_lists_its_bodies_in_
the_graphs_first_match_order to one unit test over a constructed
PatternDispatchPlan) is explicitly a SEPARATE commit and was not attempted
here; it is CPU honesty rather than wall clock, since it hides under another
gate. STEP 3 was withdrawn during scoping (no residue left to name; the two
gates measure different relations over different lists at very different
costs and both stay as emptiness ratchets). INDISTINGUISHABLE_ARM_POPULATION
still has no injection recipe -- this commit recorded the one the ticket
asked for, on the blind-escape gate.

GATE: Coordinator gate on the folded branch (marker COORD-GATE-1788477267): fmt clean, zero build warnings, clippy clean, doctests clean, lib 1710 passed / 0 failed / 5 ignored in 86.6 s, fixture matrix single-threaded 509 passed / 0 failed / 9 ignored.

comments.text: fz-kdt.183 landed (2e0bb2706): a new cost to own. InputDemand is a fact that MOVES: a function whose forwarding cone is still filling publishes a demand that climbs the lattice, and every activation keyed off it rebases. Three lenses: shift wakes 17 -> 30 / 1 -> 5 / 6 -> 25; rebased completions 19 -> 127 / 2 -> 22 / 10 -> 77; AnalyzeActivation +4/+11/+10; uncaused empty throughout. DeriveInputDemand ran exactly 2x per function at base; now long-tailed (max 17 on one function) because the cone walk restarts from scratch on every re-entry. Bounded by lattice height and cone depth; settling the demand before the first key is minted is the cure. ALSO ungated: World's evidence-collapse read of forwarded_dispatch -- flipping it to local_dispatch moves nothing on 597 fixtures (0 canon movers, 5282 executables). Either the read is inert (fold-concordant: delete it) or the corpus lacks the shape; decide with a witness, not a comment.

fz-kdt.179 landed (c3e27143d) and FOLDED YOUR STEP 1: member selection now runs through routable_alternatives, so the static seat census is retired. Deleted here: the seat gate (compiler2_dispatch_seats_the_covering_arm_where_one_covers) + SELECTION_SEAT_ALLOWANCE; BLIND_ESCAPE_POPULATION, BLIND_ESCAPE_PAIRS_ARRIVAL_KEPT, BLIND_ESCAPE_PAIRS_BY_ARM_ORDER. The blind-escape gate is now an assert-empty ratchet (proven non-vacuous: inject an escape → it fails and the tripwire returns to 12). The law lives in specificity_order's debug_assert as you specified. STILL OPEN (your steps 2-4): SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP_CENSUS is kept as an all-zero ratchet (step 4 -- decide whether the dynamic tripwire is redundant now); INDISTINGUISHABLE_ARM_POPULATION stays at 44 (fz-kdt.107's named residue, not retired); the ARM_ORDER_CENSUS corpus walks (your ~120s prize) are untouched. Re-scope this ticket to what remains.

title: Retire the static seat census once member selection runs through the seat: the law lives in specificity_order's debug_assert, the census keeps only the named residue
